EN:
You kill the trolls, and the dwarves praise you for your courage:

'Rock trolls are made of the same mould as us, so they're tough nuggets to crack. Well done, ya! Those ones were up to somethin' odd, and we had no time to deal with it.'

They leave a reward for you.

Eles deixam uma recompensa para você.
